values.meaning: cooldown and mana refund fraction on terrain hit
values.quote: 50% of ''Dredge Line's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}} are refunded

mechanics.claim: Nautilus is unable to move or attack while the anchor is in flight, but can cast other abilities during the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Nautilus''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while Dredge Line is in flight. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

mechanics.claim: If the anchor hits terrain instead of an enemy, no damage is dealt and Nautilus only dashes to the location, refunding cooldown and mana.
mechanics.quote: If the anchor hits terrain, '''Nautilus''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to that location and 50% of ''Dredge Line's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}} are refunded.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks the ability's damage but Nautilus still dashes partway to the target.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the ability but '''Nautilus''' will still dash partway to the target.

mechanics.claim: If Nautilus dies while the anchor is traveling, enemies hit are still dealt damage, but the drag and root do not apply.
mechanics.quote: The anchor projectile will stop if '''Nautilus''' dies while the projectile is traveling. Enemies hit will still be dealt damage. The {{tip|airborne|drag}} and {{tip|root}} are not applied if '''Nautilus''' did not initiate the dash.
